## Data QA and coverage

This reproduces the “weekly coverage & scale checks” used in v6.

```{r data-qc-setup, include=FALSE}
if (!exists("endpoint_bundle")) {
  endpoint_bundle <- load_endpoint_weekly(cfg = CFG)
}
endpoint_weekly_raw <- endpoint_bundle$endpoint_weekly_raw %||% endpoint_bundle$endpoint_weekly
endpoint_weekly <- endpoint_bundle$endpoint_weekly
max_rank_by_week <- endpoint_bundle$max_rank_by_week_raw %||% endpoint_bundle$max_rank_by_week
week_counts_raw <- endpoint_bundle$week_counts_raw
```

```{r qa-bad-weeks}
bad_weeks <- endpoint_bundle$bad_weeks
if (!is.null(bad_weeks) && nrow(bad_weeks) > 0) {
  bad_weeks
} else {
  tibble(note = "No weeks dropped by min_week_ranks_keep filter.")
}
```

```{r qa-summary}
endpoint_weekly_raw %>%
  summarise(
    min_week = min(week),
    max_week = max(week),
    n_weeks = n_distinct(week),
    n_endpoints = n_distinct(endpoint_id),
    max_rank_seen = max(rank)
  )
```

```{r qa-weekly-row-counts}
weekly_totals <- if (!is.null(week_counts_raw)) {
  week_counts_raw %>% dplyr::rename(n_rows = n_ranks)
} else {
  endpoint_weekly_raw %>%
    count(week, name = "n_rows") %>%
    arrange(week)
}

summary(weekly_totals$n_rows)

ggplot(weekly_totals, aes(week, n_rows)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Weekly row counts (weekly snapshots)",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Rows"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r qa-max-rank}
ggplot(max_rank_by_week, aes(week, max_rank)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Maximum observed rank by week",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Max rank"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
